title: Design System: Private Apply (Realtime Olive & Sage)

shadows.name: shadow-xs
shadows.purpose: Subtle rest elevation for cards and buttons.

motion.name: ping
motion.purpose: Pulsating beacon for active detected jobs.

components.name: Primary Action Button
components.description: Warm moss button for primary application actions.
components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg width="14" height="14" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2.5" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M12 3l1.5 4.5L18 9l-4.5 1.5L12 15l-1.5-4.5L6 9l4.5-1.5L12 3z"/></svg> Auto-Fill Application</button>
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; background: var(--primary-600); color: var(--background-50); padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Hind Vadodara', sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; border: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, transform 0.1s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--primary-700); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.98); }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Quiet sage badge for pipeline stages and verification flags.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; padding: 2px 8px; border-radius: 9999px; font-family: 'Hind Vadodara', sans-serif; font-size: 0.618rem; font-weight: 700; } .ds-chip-sage { background: var(--secondary-100); color: var(--secondary-700); border: 1px solid var(--secondary-200); }

components.name: Detected Job Card
components.description: Bordered container displaying detected ATS job with pulsating green dot.
components.html:
Senior Software Engineer
Acme Corp · Greenhouse ATS
components.css: .ds-job-card { display: flex; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; padding: 12px 14px; background: var(--background-100); border: 1px solid var(--background-200); border-radius: 8px; font-family: 'Hind Vadodara', sans-serif; } .ds-job-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; background: #4ade80; border-radius: 50%; margin-top: 4px; position: relative; } .ds-job-title { font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--text-900); } .ds-job-meta { font-size: 0.618rem; color: var(--text-600); margin-top: 2px; }

narrative.theme: Realtime Colors Earthy Olive & Sage with Golden Ratio Typography
